tasks.taskText: When an option that is NOT declared as a count is repeated with numeric values and one of those values is 1, the parser silently adds them up instead of collecting them: parser("-x 3 -x 1") returns { x: 4 } while parser("-x 3 -x 2") correctly returns { x: [3, 2] }. Repeated values must always be collected into an array ("-x 3 -x 1" gives [3, 1], "-x 1 -x 1" gives [1, 1], "-x 1 -x 3" gives [1, 3]) whatever the numbers, and options that ARE declared under count must keep incrementing exactly as before ("-v -v -v" with count: ["v"] gives 3). Nothing else about duplicate-argument handling may change. Source is lib/yargs-parser.ts; tests are compiled with npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json and run with npm test (mocha); test/yargs-parser.mjs imports the built library.
